newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firmer on higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firmer on higher volume.

text.p: Croatian stocks, helped by blue chips, closed the week mostly firmer on Friday and volume also rose as buyers came back for the last pre-Christmas session.
* Four of six traded issues rose, one fell and one was flat.
* Volume jumped to 8,751 shares, turnover to 15.5 million kuna.
* Most actively traded Zagrebacka Banka ordinary stock was also top gainer, rising 40 kuna or 4.08 percent to 1,020 kuna on a volume of 6,094 units.
* Another fully-listed issue, Pliva pharmaceutical group, added 300 kuna or 2.25 percent to 13,600 kuna, trading 666 shares.
* The only loser cables maker Elka was down 45 kuna from last week to 140 with 97 shares sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
